title: Crispy Ukrainian Beet Skillet
description: A flavorful vegetarian dish that combines the sweetness of beets with the crunch of crispy onions. This skillet is a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the skillet oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beets to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast at 425°F (220°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the beets are tender.
Top the beets with crispy fried onions and serve hot.
